definitions.explanation: A small hard piece of something, like a grain of rice or sand.
A small round drop of liquid.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粒|つぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。

examples.english: Beads of sweat appeared on his forehead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一粒|ひとつぶ}→一粒：27642_hitotsubu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残|のこ}さず→残す：01975_nokosu⟧⟦{食|た}べなさい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: Eat every single grain without leaving any.
Grains of sand got into my shoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦イチゴ→いちご：01028_ichigo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粒|つぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きくて→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧。
examples.english: These strawberries are large and sweet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粒|つぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{頬|ほお}→頬：03717_hoo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}って→伝う：28247_tsutau⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。

examples.english: Drops of morning dew were glistening on the leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大粒|おおつぶ}→大粒：15833_ootsubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{出|だ}して→降り出す：03004_furidasu⟧、⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧⟦びしょ{濡|ぬ}れ→びしょ濡れ：16748_bishonure⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Large drops of rain started falling, and I was soaked in no time.

notes:
{粒|つぶ} refers to small, often spherical particles or grains.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{一粒|ひとつぶ}→一粒：27642_hitotsubu⟧ (one grain/drop)
- {粒|つぶ}ぞろい (uniformly high quality, lit: grains well-matched)
- ⟦{米粒|こめつぶ}→米粒：28256_kometsubu⟧ (grain of rice)
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粒|つぶ} (teardrops)
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粒|つぶ} (beads of sweat)

COUNTING:
- ⟦{一粒|ひとつぶ}→一粒：27642_hitotsubu⟧、⟦{二粒|ふたつぶ}→二粒：noentry⟧、⟦{三粒|みつぶ}→三粒：noentry⟧... (one grain, two grains, three grains...)
- Also counted with {粒|つぶ} as a counter: 1{粒|つぶ}、2{粒|つぶ}...
